queries.capability: tile windows using tree paradigm
queries.en: I want my Mac windows to automatically tile in a tree layout like i3 on Linux, splitting horizontally and vertically with keyboard control. What can do that?
queries.zh: 想在 macOS 上像 Linux 的 i3 那樣用 tree 結構自動 tiling 視窗，可以用鍵盤水平或垂直分割，有什麼工具推薦？

queries.capability: run shell commands in workspace
queries.en: I want a local AI assistant running on a small Ollama model that can execute shell commands inside my project workspace for me.
queries.zh: 想找一個能在本機跑小型 Ollama 模型的 AI agent，可以直接在我的專案 workspace 裡幫我執行 shell 指令。

queries.capability: Run Claude Code on Codex login
queries.en: I pay for ChatGPT Plus and have a Codex login. Can I use that subscription to run Claude Code instead of paying for an Anthropic API key?
queries.zh: 我有 ChatGPT 訂閱，也有登入 Codex，有沒有辦法直接用這個帳號來跑 Claude Code，不用另外買 Anthropic API key？

queries.capability: Manage notes, tasks and databases
queries.en: I want one self-hosted workspace where I can keep my notes, track tasks, and build simple databases together, ideally something like Notion but where I control the data.
queries.zh: 想找一個可以自架的工作空間，把筆記、待辦事項和資料庫整合在一起管理，類似 Notion 但資料要掌握在自己手上。

queries.capability: turn audio or video into subtitles
queries.en: I need to generate subtitle files from a video recording without uploading it anywhere. Can I do it on my own machine?
queries.zh: 想把一段影片或錄音轉成字幕檔，但不想上傳到雲端，有辦法在自己電腦上跑嗎？

queries.capability: inject relevant memories instead of full chat history
queries.en: My LLM app sends the entire chat history every request and token costs are exploding. How can I inject only the relevant memories into the prompt instead?
queries.zh: 我的 LLM 應用每次 request 都把整段對話紀錄送出去，token 用量爆高。有沒有辦法只把相關的記憶塞進 prompt 就好？

queries.capability: display network utilization by process and connection
queries.en: How can I see in real time which processes and connections on my Linux server are using the most network bandwidth, from the terminal?
queries.zh: 想在 terminal 即時查看 Linux 主機上哪些 process 和連線在吃網路頻寬，有什麼工具推薦？

queries.capability: chat about screen content in speech bubbles
queries.en: I want a little animated character on my desktop that reads what's on my screen and comments on it in speech bubbles, running on a local model.
queries.zh: 想找一個桌面小角色，可以讀取我螢幕上的內容，用對話泡泡跟我聊天，最好是用本地 LLM 跑的。

queries.capability: run as audio plugin or standalone app
queries.en: I want a free virtual modular synth that I can load as a VST/LV2 plugin in my DAW or run as a standalone app.
queries.zh: 想找一個免費的虛擬模組合成器，可以當 VST/LV2 plugin 掛在 DAW 裡，也能當 standalone app 單獨執行。

queries.capability: discover open-weight models
queries.en: How can I browse and find open-weight LLMs I can download and run locally on my Mac?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以瀏覽、搜尋 open-weight 模型，然後下載到我的 Mac 本機跑？

queries.capability: record traces and extract performance insights
queries.en: I want my coding agent to record a performance trace of my site in a real browser and tell me what's slowing the page load.
queries.zh: 想讓我的 coding agent 在真的瀏覽器裡錄 performance trace，然後分析出網頁載入慢的原因，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: manage pull requests from terminal
queries.en: How can I create, review, and merge pull requests on my repos directly from the terminal without opening the browser?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法直接在 terminal 裡建立、review 和 merge pull request，不用每次都開瀏覽器？

queries.capability: Chat with models on your computer
queries.en: I want a desktop app where I can chat with AI models running entirely on my own computer, no cloud, for questions and writing help.
queries.zh: 有沒有桌面 app 可以讓我在自己電腦上跑 local LLM 聊天？不想把資料傳到雲端，主要用來問問題跟寫東西。

queries.capability: generate AI videos and cinematic shots
queries.en: I need to generate short cinematic video clips from text prompts locally on my GPU for my indie game's trailer, without using a cloud service.
queries.zh: 想在自己電腦的 GPU 上用 text prompt 生成短的電影感影片片段，拿來做獨立遊戲的預告片，不想用雲端服務，有什麼工具推薦？

queries.capability: Recommend models that fit your hardware
queries.en: Which local LLM in GGUF format can my machine actually handle? I want suggestions that fit my GPU VRAM and RAM with a decent context length.
queries.zh: 我想在本機跑 GGUF 格式的 LLM，有沒有辦法根據我的 GPU VRAM 跟 RAM，推薦塞得下、context 長度也夠用的模型？

queries.capability: convert videos to GIF animations
queries.en: I'm on a Mac and need to turn a screen recording video into a good-looking animated GIF for a README. What app should I use?
queries.zh: 我用 Mac，想把一段螢幕錄影的影片轉成畫質好一點的 GIF 動圖放在 README，有推薦的 app 嗎？

queries.capability: read repositories and code files
queries.en: I want my AI coding assistant to be able to read files and browse code in my remote repositories directly, without me copying and pasting everything into chat.
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓 AI assistant 直接讀取我遠端 repo 裡的程式碼和檔案？不想每次都手動複製貼上到對話裡。

queries.capability: browse local markdown files in TUI
queries.en: I want to browse and read the markdown files in my project folders from the terminal, with a nice interactive interface instead of opening each one in an editor.
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以在 terminal 裡用互動式介面瀏覽專案資料夾中的 markdown 檔案，不用每個都開 editor 來看？

queries.capability: run coding agents side by side
queries.en: I want to run several AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex at the same time and watch them all side by side in one window. What can do that?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以同時跑好幾個 AI coding agent，像 Claude Code 跟 Codex，然後在同一個畫面上並排看它們的進度？

queries.capability: Dictate by holding a key to type
queries.en: I want to hold down a hotkey, speak, and have my words typed into whatever app I'm in, running locally on my Mac or Linux box.
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以按住快捷鍵講話，就直接把語音轉成文字打進目前的任何 app？最好能在 Mac 或 Linux 本機跑，不要上傳雲端。

queries.capability: run and monitor many models from one TUI
queries.en: I want a terminal dashboard to launch several local LLMs (llama.cpp and vLLM) and keep an eye on all of them at once. Anything like that?
queries.zh: 有沒有可以在 terminal 裡同時啟動多個本地 LLM（llama.cpp、vLLM），並且一次監控它們狀態的介面工具？

queries.capability: organize notes into notebooks
queries.en: I need a free app where I can write Markdown notes and organize them into separate notebooks, like one for work and one for personal stuff.
queries.zh: 想找一個免費的 app 可以寫 Markdown 筆記，並把筆記分類到不同的筆記本，例如工作和個人分開放。

queries.capability: store passwords in organized encrypted entries
queries.en: I need a way to keep all my passwords organized in folders inside an encrypted file on my own computer, no cloud sync. What should I use?
queries.zh: 想找一個可以把所有密碼分類存在本機加密檔案裡的工具，不要用雲端同步，有推薦的嗎？

queries.capability: transcribe audio locally to text
queries.en: I need to transcribe audio recordings to text on my Mac without sending anything to the cloud. What can run fully offline?
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 上把錄音檔轉成文字，但不想上傳到雲端，有什麼可以完全離線跑的工具？

queries.capability: Ingest material into the graph: extract entities, link, verify
queries.en: I need my research agent to ingest papers and notes into a knowledge graph, extracting entities, linking them, and verifying the connections. What tool can do that?
queries.zh: 我想讓 research agent 把論文和筆記匯入 knowledge graph，自動抽取 entity、建立關聯並驗證，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: run interactive chat with models
queries.en: I want to chat interactively with a language model running entirely on my own Mac or Linux machine, no cloud API. What can do that?
queries.zh: 我想在自己的 Mac 或 Linux 電腦上直接跟本地跑的 LLM 互動聊天，不要用雲端 API，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: stage hunks or individual lines
queries.en: I only want to commit some of the changes in a file. How can I easily stage specific hunks or individual lines from the terminal without fiddling with git add -p?
queries.zh: 我只想 commit 檔案裡的部分修改，有沒有辦法在 terminal 裡方便地挑選特定 hunk 或單行來 stage，不用一直跟 git add -p 奮鬥？

queries.capability: preview animations in real time
queries.en: I'm drawing a walking cycle for my game character frame by frame. Is there a free editor that lets me play back the animation live while I edit the frames?
queries.zh: 我在一格一格畫遊戲角色的走路動畫，有沒有免費的編輯器可以邊改 frame 邊即時預覽動畫播放效果？

queries.capability: run AI agents on local models
queries.en: I want to run AI agents with tool use entirely on LLMs served on my own machine, like llama.cpp, instead of paying for cloud APIs. What should I use?
queries.zh: 想在自己電腦上用本地 LLM（例如 llama.cpp）跑會用工具的 AI agent，不想付雲端 API 費用，有什麼推薦的方案？

queries.capability: share files and messages nearby
queries.en: I need a free way to send files and short text messages between my laptop and phone on the same Wi-Fi, without uploading to the cloud.
queries.zh: 有沒有免費的工具可以在同一個 Wi-Fi 下，直接把檔案和文字訊息傳到旁邊的手機或電腦，不用經過雲端？

queries.capability: cut and trim video and audio losslessly
queries.en: I need to trim the beginning and end off a large video recording without re-encoding it, so the quality stays identical. What desktop app can do that quickly?
queries.zh: 想把一段很大的錄影檔頭尾剪掉，但不要重新編碼、畫質完全不變，有什麼桌面軟體可以快速做到？

queries.capability: Keep history of copied items
queries.en: I keep losing stuff I copied earlier on my Mac. Is there a way to keep a history of everything I copy so I can get it back?
queries.zh: Mac 上複製新東西就會把之前複製的蓋掉，有沒有辦法保留剪貼簿的歷史紀錄，讓我之後還能找回來？

queries.capability: Record Teams, Zoom, and Webex calls
queries.en: I need a Mac app that can record my Teams, Zoom, and Webex calls automatically without sending audio to the cloud.
queries.zh: 有沒有 Mac 上的 app 可以直接錄下 Teams、Zoom 跟 Webex 的會議通話？最好錄音不要上傳到雲端。

queries.capability: control display brightness, volume and contrast
queries.en: How can I adjust my external monitor's brightness, contrast and volume directly from my Mac instead of using the monitor's clunky physical buttons?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法直接在 Mac 上調整外接螢幕的亮度、對比和音量？不想每次都按螢幕上那些難用的實體按鈕。

queries.capability: Screen first-time senders
queries.en: I want an email app that holds messages from people who've never emailed me before until I approve or block them by address or domain.
queries.zh: 想找一個 email client，第一次寄信給我的人要先被擋下來，等我依寄件地址或網域決定允許或封鎖後才進收件匣。

queries.capability: display animated desktop companion pets
queries.en: I want a cute animated pet that walks around on my desktop while I code, ideally one that runs locally and can react to my AI coding agent.
queries.zh: 想找一個可以在桌面上走來走去的可愛動畫寵物，最好是本地執行，還能跟我的 AI coding agent 互動。

queries.capability: reason about sensor data via tiered reasoning
queries.en: I need something running on an edge device that analyzes incoming sensor readings and decides what's happening, escalating to deeper reasoning only when simple rules aren't enough.
queries.zh: 想找一個能跑在 edge 裝置上的方案，分析即時 sensor 數據並判斷狀況，簡單規則處理不了時再升級用更深入的推理。

queries.capability: switch agents mid-chat with context
queries.en: I want to swap between Claude Code, Codex and Cursor in the middle of a conversation without losing what we've already discussed. Is there a desktop app for that?
queries.zh: 有沒有桌面 app 可以在同一個對話中途切換 Claude Code、Codex 跟 Cursor，而且不會遺失之前的 context？

queries.capability: Run inference server for open models
queries.en: I want to self-host open-weight LLMs on my NVIDIA GPU or Mac and serve them through a local inference server. What should I use?
queries.zh: 想在自己的 NVIDIA GPU 或 Mac 上架設 inference server 跑開源模型，有什麼推薦的工具？

queries.capability: triage supply-chain exposure in 30 seconds
queries.en: There's news of a compromised npm package going around. How can I quickly check my laptop's lockfiles, running processes and configs for signs I've been hit?
queries.zh: 最近有 npm 套件被植入惡意程式的消息，有沒有辦法快速檢查我電腦上的 lockfile、執行中的 process 和設定檔，看看有沒有中招？

queries.capability: relay tasks to AI backends
queries.en: I want a command-line way to hand off a coding task from my current AI agent to another model like Codex or Gemini and get its answer back.
queries.zh: 有沒有 CLI 工具可以把目前 AI agent 手上的 coding 任務轉交給另一個模型（像 Codex 或 Gemini）處理，再把結果傳回來？

queries.capability: run iOS apps and games on Mac
queries.en: How can I run iPhone/iPad apps and games on my M1 MacBook? Some mobile games I play aren't available in the Mac App Store.
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法在 M1 MacBook 上跑 iOS 的 app 和手遊？有些我玩的遊戲 Mac App Store 上沒有。

queries.capability: interact with web pages via accessibility snapshots
queries.en: I want my AI assistant to click buttons and fill forms on websites by reading the page's accessibility tree instead of screenshots. How can I set that up?
queries.zh: 想讓 LLM 透過網頁的 accessibility tree 去操作頁面，像是點按鈕、填表單，而不是靠截圖辨識，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: record screens windows and applications
queries.en: I need a lightweight way to record my Mac's screen, a single window, or just one app. What should I use?
queries.zh: 想找一個輕量的 macOS 螢幕錄影工具，可以錄整個螢幕、單一視窗或指定的 app，有推薦嗎？

queries.capability: read EPUB, PDF, MOBI and other ebook formats
queries.en: I need an app that can open and read my EPUB, PDF and MOBI ebooks on both my laptop and phone.
queries.zh: 想找一個可以在電腦和手機上開啟、閱讀 EPUB、PDF 和 MOBI 電子書的 app，有推薦嗎？

queries.capability: move and resize windows with keyboard shortcuts
queries.en: On my Mac, how can I move and resize app windows using keyboard shortcuts, like snapping one to the left half of the screen?
queries.zh: 在 Mac 上有沒有辦法用快捷鍵移動和調整視窗大小？例如一鍵把視窗放到螢幕左半邊。

queries.capability: write code and verify with compiler
queries.en: I want a coding assistant running on my own machine with a local model that writes code and then checks it actually compiles and passes my project's tests.
queries.zh: 想找一個在本機跑 local model 的 coding agent，寫完 code 之後會自己用專案的 compiler 或測試驗證能不能過。

queries.capability: code with any model provider
queries.en: I want a terminal coding assistant that can edit my code using whatever model I choose, local Ollama or hosted APIs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
queries.zh: 想找一個在 terminal 跑的 AI coding agent，可以自由切換模型供應商，本地 Ollama 或 OpenAI、Anthropic 這類雲端 API 都能用來改 code。

queries.capability: reverse scrolling direction per device and app
queries.en: On my Mac I want natural scrolling on the trackpad but normal scrolling on my mouse, and ideally different settings for certain apps. How can I do that?
queries.zh: 我的 Mac 想要 trackpad 用自然捲動、滑鼠用傳統捲動方向，最好還能針對不同 app 分開設定，有什麼方法嗎？

queries.capability: search notes with hybrid FTS + vector
queries.en: I want to search my local notes using both keyword full-text matching and semantic vector similarity together. What tool can do that hybrid search?
queries.zh: 有沒有工具可以同時用全文關鍵字和 vector 語意相似度來搜尋我本機的筆記？想要那種 hybrid search 的效果。

queries.capability: semantic code retrieval and editing
queries.en: My coding agent wastes tokens grepping whole files; I want it to look up and edit code by symbol, like an IDE does, through an MCP server.
queries.zh: 我的 coding agent 每次都 grep 整個檔案很浪費 token，有沒有 MCP server 可以讓它像 IDE 一樣用 symbol 層級去查找和修改程式碼？

queries.capability: keep long-running processes alive
queries.en: I need something on my Linux server that keeps a few long-running processes alive and automatically restarts them if they crash.
queries.zh: 我想在 Linux server 上讓幾個長時間執行的 process 一直保持運作，掛掉的話要能自動重啟，有什麼工具推薦？

queries.capability: monitor CPU utilization
queries.en: I want to see my Mac's CPU usage at a glance in the menu bar while I work. Is there a lightweight app for that?
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 的 menu bar 上隨時看到 CPU 使用率，有沒有輕量一點的 app 推薦？

queries.capability: count tokens with exact OpenAI tokenizers
queries.en: I need to count exactly how many tokens a text file uses with OpenAI's tokenizer, locally, without calling the API.
queries.zh: 想在本機精準計算一個文字檔用 OpenAI tokenizer 會是多少 tokens，不想打 API，有什麼工具可以用？

queries.capability: hide unneeded menu bar items
queries.en: My Mac's menu bar is cluttered with icons from apps I rarely use. How can I hide the ones I don't need?
queries.zh: 我的 Mac 選單列塞滿一堆很少用的 app 圖示，有沒有辦法把不需要的藏起來？

queries.capability: Prove which traffic can move without losing quality
queries.en: How can I check which of my OpenAI API calls could switch to a self-hosted open-weight model without the output quality getting worse?
queries.zh: 想知道我們的 OpenAI API 請求裡，哪些可以改用自架的 open-weight model 而不會降低品質，有什麼方法可以驗證？

queries.capability: Dictate text into any app with a hotkey
queries.en: I want to press a keyboard shortcut on my Mac and speak, and have the words typed into whatever app I'm using, ideally offline.
queries.zh: 想在 Mac 上按個快捷鍵就能用講的，把語音直接打字到目前開著的任何 app 裡，最好可以離線使用。

queries.capability: keep billion-token pool on local disk
queries.en: How can I give my small local LLM access to a memory pool of around a billion tokens stored on my own disk instead of in RAM?
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法讓我本機跑的小型 LLM 存取放在硬碟上、大約十億 token 的記憶庫，而不是全部塞進 RAM？

queries.capability: Ask spoken questions in terminal
queries.en: I want to speak a question out loud in my terminal and get an answer from a local LLM, without typing anything.
queries.zh: 有沒有辦法在 terminal 直接用講的問問題，然後讓本機的 LLM 回答？不想用打字的。

queries.capability: transcribe speech to text locally
queries.en: I need to transcribe speech from audio recordings into text on my own machine using the GPU, without sending anything to a cloud service.
queries.zh: 想在自己的電腦上用 GPU 把錄音檔的語音轉成文字，不要上傳到雲端服務，有什麼工具推薦？

queries.capability: Mention coding agents in group chat
queries.en: I want my team to @mention AI coding agents like Claude Code or Codex in a shared group chat and have them do repo work and reply in threads.
queries.zh: 想找一個團隊群組聊天工具，可以直接 @ Claude Code 或 Codex 這類 coding agent 幫忙改 repo，然後在 thread 裡回覆結果。

queries.capability: serve models via OpenAI-compatible API
queries.en: I want to run a GGUF model on my own machine and expose it through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint so my existing client code works unchanged.
queries.zh: 想在自己的機器上跑 GGUF 模型，並開一個 OpenAI-compatible 的 HTTP API，讓現有的 client 程式不用改就能直接接。

queries.capability: govern existing coding agent with hooks and rules
queries.en: How can I put guardrails on my coding agent like Claude Code or Cursor, using hooks and rules to block risky commands before they run?
queries.zh: 想幫 Claude Code 或 Cursor 這類 coding agent 加上 hooks 跟規則，在執行危險指令前先擋下來，有什麼工具可以做到？

queries.capability: manage files in terminal asynchronously
queries.en: I want a fast keyboard-driven file browser in my terminal that doesn't freeze when copying large directories or loading big folders.
queries.zh: 想找一個在 terminal 裡用鍵盤操作的檔案管理工具，複製大資料夾或開很多檔案的目錄時不會卡住。

queries.capability: manage floating and stacked panes
queries.en: I want a terminal tool where I can pop up floating panes over my work and stack panes on top of each other instead of just splitting the screen.
queries.zh: 有沒有終端機工具可以開 floating panes 浮在畫面上，還能把 panes 疊起來 stack，而不是只能切割視窗？
